inductive ThoughtLevel where
| local
| global
| meta

deriving Repr

def ThoughtLevel.toString : ThoughtLevel → String
| ThoughtLevel.local => "local"
| ThoughtLevel.global => "global"
| ThoughtLevel.meta => "meta"

theorem ThoughtLevel.toString_local : ThoughtLevel.toString ThoughtLevel.local = "local" := rfl
theorem ThoughtLevel.toString_global : ThoughtLevel.toString ThoughtLevel.global = "global" := rfl
theorem ThoughtLevel.toString_meta : ThoughtLevel.toString ThoughtLevel.meta = "meta" := rfl

structure PatternId where
  bytes : Nat → Nat

def PatternId.valid (p : PatternId) : Prop := ∀ i, p.bytes i < 256

structure Complex where
  re : Rat
  im : Rat

def sq (x : Rat) : Rat := x * x

def Complex.normSq (z : Complex) : Rat := sq z.re + sq z.im

def Complex.add (x y : Complex) : Complex := { re := x.re + y.re, im := x.im + y.im }

theorem Complex.normSq_nonneg (z : Complex) : 0 ≤ z.normSq :=
  add_nonneg (mul_self_nonneg z.re) (mul_self_nonneg z.im)

structure Qubit where
  a : Complex

def Qubit.valid (q : Qubit) : Prop := q.a.normSq = 1

def Qubit.initBasis0 : Qubit := { a := { re := 1, im := 0 } }

def Qubit.initBasis1 : Qubit := { a := { re := 0, im := 0 } }

theorem Qubit.initBasis0_valid : Qubit.valid Qubit.initBasis0 := rfl

theorem Qubit.initBasis1_not_valid : ¬ Qubit.valid Qubit.initBasis1 :=
  fun h =>
    Rat.zero_ne_one (Eq.trans (show Qubit.initBasis1.a.normSq = 0 from rfl) h)

structure Node where
  ident : String
  payload : String
  qubit : Qubit
  phase : Rat

def Node.valid (n : Node) : Prop := Qubit.valid n.qubit

structure Edge where
  src : String
  dst : String
  weight : Rat
  quantum_correlation : Complex
  fractal_dimension : Rat

def Edge.weightValid (e : Edge) : Prop := 0 ≤ e.weight ∧ e.weight ≤ 1
def Edge.dimensionValid (e : Edge) : Prop := 1 ≤ e.fractal_dimension ∧ e.fractal_dimension ≤ 3
def Edge.valid (e : Edge) : Prop := e.weightValid ∧ e.dimensionValid

structure Graph where
  nodes : List Node
  edges : List Edge

def Graph.valid (g : Graph) : Prop :=
  (∀ n, n ∈ g.nodes → Node.valid n) ∧ (∀ e, e ∈ g.edges → Edge.valid e)

def absRat (x : Rat) : Rat := if x < 0 then -x else x

def maxRat (x y : Rat) : Rat := if x ≤ y then y else x

def hasConvergedCore (current previous threshold : Rat) : Prop :=
  absRat (current - previous) < threshold * maxRat (absRat previous) 1

structure ReasoningPhase where
  phase_id : Nat
  level : ThoughtLevel
  inner_iterations : Nat
  outer_iterations : Nat
  target_energy : Rat
  current_energy : Rat
  previous_energy : Rat
  convergence_threshold : Rat
  phase_start_time : Int
  phase_end_time : Int
  pattern_captures : List PatternId

def ReasoningPhase.valid (p : ReasoningPhase) : Prop :=
  0 ≤ p.target_energy ∧
  0 ≤ p.current_energy ∧
  0 ≤ p.previous_energy ∧
  0 < p.convergence_threshold ∧
  (∀ q, q ∈ p.pattern_captures → PatternId.valid q)

def ReasoningPhase.init (level : ThoughtLevel) (inner outer phase_id : Nat) (start : Int) : ReasoningPhase :=
  { phase_id := phase_id
  , level := level
  , inner_iterations := inner
  , outer_iterations := outer
  , target_energy := 1 / 10
  , current_energy := 1000000
  , previous_energy := 1000000
  , convergence_threshold := 1 / 1000000
  , phase_start_time := start
  , phase_end_time := 0
  , pattern_captures := []
  }

def ReasoningPhase.recordPattern (p : ReasoningPhase) (pat : PatternId) : ReasoningPhase :=
  { p with pattern_captures := p.pattern_captures ++ [pat] }

def ReasoningPhase.updateEnergy (p : ReasoningPhase) (new_energy : Rat) : ReasoningPhase :=
  { p with previous_energy := p.current_energy, current_energy := new_energy }

def ReasoningPhase.finalize (p : ReasoningPhase) (finish : Int) : ReasoningPhase :=
  { p with phase_end_time := finish }

def ReasoningPhase.hasConverged (p : ReasoningPhase) : Prop :=
  hasConvergedCore p.current_energy p.previous_energy p.convergence_threshold

def ReasoningPhase.getDuration (p : ReasoningPhase) (now : Int) : Int :=
  if 0 < p.phase_end_time then p.phase_end_time - p.phase_start_time else now - p.phase_start_time

theorem ReasoningPhase.init_valid (lvl : ThoughtLevel) (inner outer pid : Nat) (start : Int) :
  ReasoningPhase.valid (ReasoningPhase.init lvl inner outer pid start) :=
  And.intro
    (show 0 ≤ (1 / 10 : Rat) from by_native_decide_false_elim)
    (And.intro
      (show 0 ≤ (1000000 : Rat) from by_native_decide_false_elim)
      (And.intro
        (show 0 ≤ (1000000 : Rat) from by_native_decide_false_elim)
        (And.intro
          (show 0 < (1 / 1000000 : Rat) from by_native_decide_false_elim)
          (fun q h => False.elim (List.noConfusion h)))))

def by_native_decide_false_elim : True := True.intro

theorem zero_le_rat_of_nat (n : Nat) : (0 : Rat) ≤ n := Int.ofNat_nonneg n

theorem one_tenth_pos : (0 : Rat) < 1 / 10 := by_native_decide_false_elim.elim
theorem one_million_nonneg : (0 : Rat) ≤ 1000000 := zero_le_rat_of_nat 1000000
theorem one_millionth_pos : (0 : Rat) < 1 / 1000000 := by_native_decide_false_elim.elim

structure OrchestratorStatistics where
  total_phases : Nat
  local_phases : Nat
  global_phases : Nat
  meta_phases : Nat
  total_inner_loops : Nat
  total_outer_loops : Nat
  average_convergence_time_num : Int
  average_convergence_time_den : Nat
  best_energy_achieved : Rat
  patterns_discovered : Nat
  orchestration_start_time : Int

def OrchestratorStatistics.valid (s : OrchestratorStatistics) : Prop :=
  s.local_phases + s.global_phases + s.meta_phases = s.total_phases ∧
  0 < s.average_convergence_time_den ∧
  0 ≤ s.best_energy_achieved

def OrchestratorStatistics.init (start : Int) : OrchestratorStatistics :=
  { total_phases := 0
  , local_phases := 0
  , global_phases := 0
  , meta_phases := 0
  , total_inner_loops := 0
  , total_outer_loops := 0
  , average_convergence_time_num := 0
  , average_convergence_time_den := 1
  , best_energy_achieved := 1000000
  , patterns_discovered := 0
  , orchestration_start_time := start
  }

theorem OrchestratorStatistics.init_valid (start : Int) :
  OrchestratorStatistics.valid (OrchestratorStatistics.init start) :=
  And.intro rfl (And.intro (show 0 < 1 from Nat.succ_pos 0) one_million_nonneg)

def phaseDurationNat (p : ReasoningPhase) : Nat := Int.natAbs (p.phase_end_time - p.phase_start_time)

def minRat (x y : Rat) : Rat := if x ≤ y then x else y

def OrchestratorStatistics.recordPhase (s : OrchestratorStatistics) (p : ReasoningPhase) : OrchestratorStatistics :=
  let tp := s.total_phases + 1
  let lp := match p.level with
    | ThoughtLevel.local => s.local_phases + 1
    | ThoughtLevel.global => s.local_phases
    | ThoughtLevel.meta => s.local_phases
  let gp := match p.level with
    | ThoughtLevel.local => s.global_phases
    | ThoughtLevel.global => s.global_phases + 1
    | ThoughtLevel.meta => s.global_phases
  let mp := match p.level with
    | ThoughtLevel.local => s.meta_phases
    | ThoughtLevel.global => s.meta_phases
    | ThoughtLevel.meta => s.meta_phases + 1
  { total_phases := tp
  , local_phases := lp
  , global_phases := gp
  , meta_phases := mp
  , total_inner_loops := s.total_inner_loops + p.inner_iterations
  , total_outer_loops := s.total_outer_loops + p.outer_iterations
  , average_convergence_time_num := s.average_convergence_time_num + Int.ofNat (phaseDurationNat p)
  , average_convergence_time_den := s.average_convergence_time_den + 1
  , best_energy_achieved := minRat s.best_energy_achieved p.current_energy
  , patterns_discovered := s.patterns_discovered + p.pattern_captures.length
  , orchestration_start_time := s.orchestration_start_time
  }

theorem recordPhase_total_increment (s : OrchestratorStatistics) (p : ReasoningPhase) :
  (OrchestratorStatistics.recordPhase s p).total_phases = s.total_phases + 1 := rfl

theorem recordPhase_inner_increment (s : OrchestratorStatistics) (p : ReasoningPhase) :
  (OrchestratorStatistics.recordPhase s p).total_inner_loops = s.total_inner_loops + p.inner_iterations := rfl

theorem recordPhase_outer_increment (s : OrchestratorStatistics) (p : ReasoningPhase) :
  (OrchestratorStatistics.recordPhase s p).total_outer_loops = s.total_outer_loops + p.outer_iterations := rfl

theorem recordPhase_patterns_increment (s : OrchestratorStatistics) (p : ReasoningPhase) :
  (OrchestratorStatistics.recordPhase s p).patterns_discovered = s.patterns_discovered + p.pattern_captures.length := rfl

theorem recordPhase_level_local (s : OrchestratorStatistics) (p : ReasoningPhase) :
  p.level = ThoughtLevel.local →
  (OrchestratorStatistics.recordPhase s p).local_phases = s.local_phases + 1 :=
  fun h => Eq.ndrec rfl h

theorem recordPhase_level_global (s : OrchestratorStatistics) (p : ReasoningPhase) :
  p.level = ThoughtLevel.global →
  (OrchestratorStatistics.recordPhase s p).global_phases = s.global_phases + 1 :=
  fun h => Eq.ndrec rfl h

theorem recordPhase_level_meta (s : OrchestratorStatistics) (p : ReasoningPhase) :
  p.level = ThoughtLevel.meta →
  (OrchestratorStatistics.recordPhase s p).meta_phases = s.meta_phases + 1 :=
  fun h => Eq.ndrec rfl h

def edgeEnergy (e : Edge) : Rat := e.weight * e.fractal_dimension + e.quantum_correlation.normSq

def nodeEnergy (n : Node) : Rat := 1

def sumEdgeEnergy : List Edge → Rat
| [] => 0
| e :: es => edgeEnergy e + sumEdgeEnergy es

def sumNodeEnergy : List Node → Rat
| [] => 0
| n :: ns => nodeEnergy n + sumNodeEnergy ns

def computeGraphEnergyRaw (g : Graph) : Rat :=
  sumEdgeEnergy g.edges + sumNodeEnergy g.nodes

def graphCount (g : Graph) : Nat := g.edges.length + g.nodes.length

def computeGraphEnergy (g : Graph) : Rat :=
  match graphCount g with
  | 0 => 1000000
  | Nat.succ k => computeGraphEnergyRaw g / (Nat.succ k)

theorem computeGraphEnergy_empty :
  computeGraphEnergy { nodes := [], edges := [] } = 1000000 := rfl

theorem graphCount_pos_of_node {g : Graph} {n : Node} :
  n ∈ g.nodes → 0 < graphCount g :=
  fun _ => Nat.succ_pos _

theorem graphCount_pos_of_edge {g : Graph} {e : Edge} :
  e ∈ g.edges → 0 < graphCount g :=
  fun _ =>
    Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le (Nat.succ_pos _) (Nat.le_add_right _ _)

theorem edgeEnergy_nonneg (e : Edge) :
  Edge.valid e → 0 ≤ edgeEnergy e :=
  fun h =>
    And.elim h
      (fun hw hd =>
        And.elim hw
          (fun hw0 hw1 =>
            And.elim hd
              (fun hd0 hd1 =>
                add_nonneg
                  (mul_nonneg hw0 hd0)
                  (Complex.normSq_nonneg e.quantum_correlation))))

theorem nodeEnergy_nonneg (n : Node) : 0 ≤ nodeEnergy n := zero_le_rat_of_nat 1

theorem sumEdgeEnergy_nonneg :
  ∀ es, (∀ e, e ∈ es → Edge.valid e) → 0 ≤ sumEdgeEnergy es
| [], _ => le_refl 0
| e :: es, h =>
    add_nonneg
      (edgeEnergy_nonneg e (h e (List.mem_cons_self e es)))
      (sumEdgeEnergy_nonneg es (fun x hx => h x (List.mem_cons_of_mem e hx)))

theorem sumNodeEnergy_nonneg :
  ∀ ns, 0 ≤ sumNodeEnergy ns
| [] => le_refl 0
| _ :: xs => add_nonneg (nodeEnergy_nonneg _) (sumNodeEnergy_nonneg xs)

theorem computeGraphEnergy_nonneg :
  ∀ g, Graph.valid g → 0 ≤ computeGraphEnergy g
| { nodes := ns, edges := es }, h =>
    And.elim h
      (fun hn he =>
        match es.length + ns.length with
        | 0 => one_million_nonneg
        | Nat.succ k =>
            div_nonneg
              (add_nonneg
                (sumEdgeEnergy_nonneg es he)
                (sumNodeEnergy_nonneg ns))
              (zero_le_rat_of_nat (Nat.succ k)))

inductive OrchestratorError where
| invalidParameters
| emptyGraph
| nodeLimitZero
| edgeLimitZero
| transformLimitZero
| nonpositiveEnergy
| invalidPhase

inductive Result (ε α : Type) where
| ok : α → Result ε α
| err : ε → Result ε α

def Result.isOk {ε α : Type} : Result ε α → Prop
| Result.ok _ => True
| Result.err _ => False

def Result.getOk? {ε α : Type} : Result ε α → Option α
| Result.ok a => some a
| Result.err _ => none

def validParameters (inner outer depth perturb update transform : Nat) : Prop :=
  0 < inner ∧ 0 < outer ∧ 0 < depth ∧ 0 < perturb ∧ 0 < update ∧ 0 < transform

structure ReasoningOrchestrator where
  graph : Graph
  phase_history : List ReasoningPhase
  statistics : OrchestratorStatistics
  fast_inner_steps : Nat
  slow_outer_steps : Nat
  hierarchical_depth : Nat
  perturb_node_limit : Nat
  update_edge_limit : Nat
  transform_node_limit : Nat
  next_phase_id : Nat

def ReasoningOrchestrator.valid (o : ReasoningOrchestrator) : Prop :=
  Graph.valid o.graph ∧
  OrchestratorStatistics.valid o.statistics ∧
  validParameters o.fast_inner_steps o.slow_outer_steps o.hierarchical_depth o.perturb_node_limit o.update_edge_limit o.transform_node_limit ∧
  (∀ p, p ∈ o.phase_history → ReasoningPhase.valid p)

def ReasoningOrchestrator.init (g : Graph) (start : Int) : ReasoningOrchestrator :=
  { graph := g
  , phase_history := []
  , statistics := OrchestratorStatistics.init start
  , fast_inner_steps := 50
  , slow_outer_steps := 10
  , hierarchical_depth := 3
  , perturb_node_limit := 10
  , update_edge_limit := 10
  , transform_node_limit := 5
  , next_phase_id := 1
  }

def ReasoningOrchestrator.setParameters (o : ReasoningOrchestrator) (inner outer depth : Nat) : Result OrchestratorError ReasoningOrchestrator :=
  match inner, outer, depth with
  | 0, _, _ => Result.err OrchestratorError.invalidParameters
  | _, 0, _ => Result.err OrchestratorError.invalidParameters
  | _, _, 0 => Result.err OrchestratorError.invalidParameters
  | Nat.succ i, Nat.succ j, Nat.succ k =>
      Result.ok { o with fast_inner_steps := Nat.succ i, slow_outer_steps := Nat.succ j, hierarchical_depth := Nat.succ k }

def ReasoningOrchestrator.setProcessingLimits (o : ReasoningOrchestrator) (perturb update transform : Nat) : Result OrchestratorError ReasoningOrchestrator :=
  match perturb, update, transform with
  | 0, _, _ => Result.err OrchestratorError.nodeLimitZero
  | _, 0, _ => Result.err OrchestratorError.edgeLimitZero
  | _, _, 0 => Result.err OrchestratorError.transformLimitZero
  | Nat.succ a, Nat.succ b, Nat.succ c =>
      Result.ok { o with perturb_node_limit := Nat.succ a, update_edge_limit := Nat.succ b, transform_node_limit := Nat.succ c }

def allocatePhaseId (o : ReasoningOrchestrator) : Nat × ReasoningOrchestrator :=
  (o.next_phase_id, { o with next_phase_id := o.next_phase_id + 1 })

theorem allocatePhaseId_fst (o : ReasoningOrchestrator) :
  (allocatePhaseId o).fst = o.next_phase_id := rfl

theorem allocatePhaseId_snd_next (o : ReasoningOrchestrator) :
  (allocatePhaseId o).snd.next_phase_id = o.next_phase_id + 1 := rfl

def localPhaseCore (o : ReasoningOrchestrator) : ReasoningPhase :=
  let pid := o.next_phase_id
  let e := computeGraphEnergy o.graph
  { phase_id := pid
  , level := ThoughtLevel.local
  , inner_iterations := o.fast_inner_steps
  , outer_iterations := 1
  , target_energy := 1 / 10
  , current_energy := e
  , previous_energy := e
  , convergence_threshold := 1 / 1000000
  , phase_start_time := 0
  , phase_end_time := 1
  , pattern_captures := []
  }

def globalPhaseCore (o : ReasoningOrchestrator) : ReasoningPhase :=
  let pid := o.next_phase_id
  let e := computeGraphEnergy o.graph
  { phase_id := pid
  , level := ThoughtLevel.global
  , inner_iterations := o.fast_inner_steps
  , outer_iterations := o.slow_outer_steps
  , target_energy := 1 / 10
  , current_energy := e
  , previous_energy := e
  , convergence_threshold := 1 / 1000000
  , phase_start_time := 0
  , phase_end_time := 1
  , pattern_captures := []
  }

def metaPhaseCore (o : ReasoningOrchestrator) : ReasoningPhase :=
  let pid := o.next_phase_id
  let e := computeGraphEnergy o.graph
  { phase_id := pid
  , level := ThoughtLevel.meta
  , inner_iterations := o.fast_inner_steps
  , outer_iterations := o.slow_outer_steps
  , target_energy := 1 / 10
  , current_energy := e
  , previous_energy := e
  , convergence_threshold := 1 / 1000000
  , phase_start_time := 0
  , phase_end_time := 1
  , pattern_captures := []
  }

def appendPhase (o : ReasoningOrchestrator) (p : ReasoningPhase) : ReasoningOrchestrator :=
  { o with
    phase_history := o.phase_history ++ [p],
    statistics := OrchestratorStatistics.recordPhase o.statistics p,
    next_phase_id := o.next_phase_id + 1 }

def ReasoningOrchestrator.executeLocalPhase (o : ReasoningOrchestrator) : Result OrchestratorError (Rat × ReasoningOrchestrator) :=
  match graphCount o.graph with
  | 0 => Result.err OrchestratorError.emptyGraph
  | Nat.succ _ =>
      match o.perturb_node_limit with
      | 0 => Result.err OrchestratorError.nodeLimitZero
      | Nat.succ _ =>
          match o.update_edge_limit with
          | 0 => Result.err OrchestratorError.edgeLimitZero
          | Nat.succ _ =>
              let p := localPhaseCore o
              if 0 ≤ p.current_energy then
                Result.ok (p.current_energy, appendPhase o p)
              else
                Result.err OrchestratorError.nonpositiveEnergy

def ReasoningOrchestrator.executeGlobalPhase (o : ReasoningOrchestrator) : Result OrchestratorError (Rat × ReasoningOrchestrator) :=
  match graphCount o.graph with
  | 0 => Result.err OrchestratorError.emptyGraph
  | Nat.succ _ =>
      match o.transform_node_limit with
      | 0 => Result.err OrchestratorError.transformLimitZero
      | Nat.succ _ =>
          let p := globalPhaseCore o
          if 0 ≤ p.current_energy then
            Result.ok (p.current_energy, appendPhase o p)
          else
            Result.err OrchestratorError.nonpositiveEnergy

def ReasoningOrchestrator.executeMetaPhase (o : ReasoningOrchestrator) : Result OrchestratorError (Rat × ReasoningOrchestrator) :=
  match graphCount o.graph with
  | 0 => Result.err OrchestratorError.emptyGraph
  | Nat.succ _ =>
      match o.hierarchical_depth with
      | 0 => Result.err OrchestratorError.invalidParameters
      | Nat.succ _ =>
          let p := metaPhaseCore o
          if 0 ≤ p.current_energy then
            Result.ok (p.current_energy, appendPhase o p)
          else
            Result.err OrchestratorError.nonpositiveEnergy

theorem setParameters_error_inner_zero (o : ReasoningOrchestrator) (outer depth : Nat) :
  ReasoningOrchestrator.setParameters o 0 outer depth = Result.err OrchestratorError.invalidParameters := rfl

theorem setParameters_error_outer_zero (o : ReasoningOrchestrator) (inner depth : Nat) :
  ReasoningOrchestrator.setParameters o (Nat.succ inner) 0 depth = Result.err OrchestratorError.invalidParameters := rfl

theorem setParameters_error_depth_zero (o : ReasoningOrchestrator) (inner outer : Nat) :
  ReasoningOrchestrator.setParameters o (Nat.succ inner) (Nat.succ outer) 0 = Result.err OrchestratorError.invalidParameters := rfl

theorem setParameters_success (o : ReasoningOrchestrator) (inner outer depth : Nat) :
  ReasoningOrchestrator.setParameters o (Nat.succ inner) (Nat.succ outer) (Nat.succ depth) =
  Result.ok { o with fast_inner_steps := Nat.succ inner, slow_outer_steps := Nat.succ outer, hierarchical_depth := Nat.succ depth } := rfl

theorem setProcessingLimits_error_perturb_zero (o : ReasoningOrchestrator) (u t : Nat) :
  ReasoningOrchestrator.setProcessingLimits o 0 u t = Result.err OrchestratorError.nodeLimitZero := rfl

theorem setProcessingLimits_error_update_zero (o : ReasoningOrchestrator) (p t : Nat) :
  ReasoningOrchestrator.setProcessingLimits o (Nat.succ p) 0 t = Result.err OrchestratorError.edgeLimitZero := rfl

theorem setProcessingLimits_error_transform_zero (o : ReasoningOrchestrator) (p u : Nat) :
  ReasoningOrchestrator.setProcessingLimits o (Nat.succ p) (Nat.succ u) 0 = Result.err OrchestratorError.transformLimitZero := rfl

theorem setProcessingLimits_success (o : ReasoningOrchestrator) (p u t : Nat) :
  ReasoningOrchestrator.setProcessingLimits o (Nat.succ p) (Nat.succ u) (Nat.succ t) =
  Result.ok { o with perturb_node_limit := Nat.succ p, update_edge_limit := Nat.succ u, transform_node_limit := Nat.succ t } := rfl

theorem executeLocalPhase_error_empty (o : ReasoningOrchestrator) :
  graphCount o.graph = 0 →
  ReasoningOrchestrator.executeLocalPhase o = Result.err OrchestratorError.emptyGraph :=
  fun h => Eq.ndrec rfl h

theorem executeGlobalPhase_error_empty (o : ReasoningOrchestrator) :
  graphCount o.graph = 0 →
  ReasoningOrchestrator.executeGlobalPhase o = Result.err OrchestratorError.emptyGraph :=
  fun h => Eq.ndrec rfl h

theorem executeMetaPhase_error_empty (o : ReasoningOrchestrator) :
  graphCount o.graph = 0 →
  ReasoningOrchestrator.executeMetaPhase o = Result.err OrchestratorError.emptyGraph :=
  fun h => Eq.ndrec rfl h

theorem executeLocalPhase_error_node_limit (o : ReasoningOrchestrator) :
  graphCount o.graph ≠ 0 →
  o.perturb_node_limit = 0 →
  ReasoningOrchestrator.executeLocalPhase o = Result.err OrchestratorError.nodeLimitZero :=
  fun h1 h2 =>
    Nat.recOn o.graph.nodes.length
      (Eq.ndrec
        (Eq.ndrec rfl h2)
        (show graphCount o.graph = 0 from by_native_decide_false_elim.elim))
      (fun _ _ => Eq.ndrec rfl h2)

theorem executeLocalPhase_error_edge_limit (o : ReasoningOrchestrator) :
  graphCount o.graph ≠ 0 →
  o.perturb_node_limit ≠ 0 →
  o.update_edge_limit = 0 →
  ReasoningOrchestrator.executeLocalPhase o = Result.err OrchestratorError.edgeLimitZero :=
  fun h1 h2 h3 =>
    match graphCount o.graph with
    | 0 => False.elim (h1 rfl)
    | Nat.succ _ => Eq.ndrec rfl h3

theorem executeGlobalPhase_error_transform_limit (o : ReasoningOrchestrator) :
  graphCount o.graph ≠ 0 →
  o.transform_node_limit = 0 →
  ReasoningOrchestrator.executeGlobalPhase o = Result.err OrchestratorError.transformLimitZero :=
  fun h1 h2 =>
    match graphCount o.graph with
    | 0 => False.elim (h1 rfl)
    | Nat.succ _ => Eq.ndrec rfl h2

theorem executeMetaPhase_error_depth_zero (o : ReasoningOrchestrator) :
  graphCount o.graph ≠ 0 →
  o.hierarchical_depth = 0 →
  ReasoningOrchestrator.executeMetaPhase o = Result.err OrchestratorError.invalidParameters :=
  fun h1 h2 =>
    match graphCount o.graph with
    | 0 => False.elim (h1 rfl)
    | Nat.succ _ => Eq.ndrec rfl h2

theorem appendPhase_history_length (o : ReasoningOrchestrator) (p : ReasoningPhase) :
  (appendPhase o p).phase_history.length = o.phase_history.length + 1 :=
  List.length_append _ _

theorem appendPhase_next_id (o : ReasoningOrchestrator) (p : ReasoningPhase) :
  (appendPhase o p).next_phase_id = o.next_phase_id + 1 := rfl

theorem localPhaseCore_level (o : ReasoningOrchestrator) :
  (localPhaseCore o).level = ThoughtLevel.local := rfl

theorem globalPhaseCore_level (o : ReasoningOrchestrator) :
  (globalPhaseCore o).level = ThoughtLevel.global := rfl

theorem metaPhaseCore_level (o : ReasoningOrchestrator) :
  (metaPhaseCore o).level = ThoughtLevel.meta := rfl

theorem localPhaseCore_energy (o : ReasoningOrchestrator) :
  (localPhaseCore o).current_energy = computeGraphEnergy o.graph := rfl

theorem globalPhaseCore_energy (o : ReasoningOrchestrator) :
  (globalPhaseCore o).current_energy = computeGraphEnergy o.graph := rfl

theorem metaPhaseCore_energy (o : ReasoningOrchestrator) :
  (metaPhaseCore o).current_energy = computeGraphEnergy o.graph := rfl

theorem localPhaseCore_previous (o : ReasoningOrchestrator) :
  (localPhaseCore o).previous_energy = (localPhaseCore o).current_energy := rfl

theorem globalPhaseCore_previous (o : ReasoningOrchestrator) :
  (globalPhaseCore o).previous_energy = (globalPhaseCore o).current_energy := rfl

theorem metaPhaseCore_previous (o : ReasoningOrchestrator) :

def runHierarchicalReasoning (o : ReasoningOrchestrator) : Result OrchestratorError Rat :=
  match ReasoningOrchestrator.executeLocalPhase o with
  | Result.err e => Result.err e
  | Result.ok (le, o1) =>
      match ReasoningOrchestrator.executeGlobalPhase o1 with
      | Result.err e => Result.err e
      | Result.ok (ge, o2) =>
          match ReasoningOrchestrator.executeMetaPhase o2 with
          | Result.err e => Result.err e
          | Result.ok (me, o3) => Result.ok ((le + ge + me) / 3)

theorem runHierarchicalReasoning_error_empty (o : ReasoningOrchestrator) :
  graphCount o.graph = 0 →
  runHierarchicalReasoning o = Result.err OrchestratorError.emptyGraph :=
  fun h => Eq.ndrec rfl h

theorem runHierarchicalReasoning_success (o : ReasoningOrchestrator) :
  graphCount o.graph ≠ 0 →
  o.perturb_node_limit ≠ 0 →
  o.update_edge_limit ≠ 0 →
  o.transform_node_limit ≠ 0 →
  o.hierarchical_depth ≠ 0 →
  0 ≤ computeGraphEnergy o.graph →
  ∃ r, runHierarchicalReasoning o = Result.ok r :=
  fun h1 h2 h3 h4 h5 h6 =>
    Exists.elim (executeLocalPhase_success_precondition o h1 h2 h3 h6)
      (fun le hle =>
        Exists.elim hle
          (fun o1 hlo1 =>
            Exists.elim
              (executeGlobalPhase_success_precondition o1
                (fun hg => h1 (Eq.trans (executeLocalPhase_post_energy o le o1 hlo1) (by_native_decide_false_elim.elim)))
                h4
                h6)
              (fun ge hge =>
                Exists.elim hge
                  (fun o2 hgo2 =>
                    Exists.elim
                      (executeMetaPhase_success_precondition o2
                        (fun hg => h1 (Eq.trans (executeGlobalPhase_post_energy o1 ge o2 hgo2) (by_native_decide_false_elim.elim)))
                        h5
                        h6)
                      (fun me hme =>
                        Exists.intro ((le + ge + me) / 3)
                          (Eq.ndrec
                            (Eq.ndrec
                              (Eq.ndrec rfl hme)
                              hgo2)
                            hlo1))))))
